# wisp-science v1.23.0 — Workers and Recovery

**Subagents can run on a cheaper model, and a cut model stream no longer ends the turn.** You can choose a separate model for subagents, globally or per conversation. When a model response stream drops mid-answer, Wisp reconnects inside the running turn. Wisp can also use a model connection provided by the Magpie Agent plugin, and idle MCP processes are stopped.

## Subagent model

- **Settings → Specialists → Default subagent model** sets the model that `delegate_tasks` children and `dispatch_subagent` conversations run on. It takes precedence over the conversation's model, so one setting keeps every worker off an expensive model.
- The composer agent menu has a new **Subagent model** row next to **Reviewer model**. You can pick a profile for this conversation, or **Follow this conversation**. A Specialist's own model binding and explicit task overrides still come first.
- When a separate worker model is set, the Agent can mark a task `inherit` to run it on the conversation's model when it needs the full capability. The Agents panel shows the model each task and subagent conversation runs on.

## Blocked subagents ask you

- A subagent that needs an install beyond one project-local attempt, administrator rights, credentials or access, system-wide or network settings, or a decision from you now stops and hands the request back. It says what it needs and the exact command or options.
- A subagent stopped at its step limit now makes the parent Agent report and ask you with `ask_user`, instead of only appending a summary. The subagent does not run again until you answer, so it cannot loop through the limit. See [agent delegation](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.23.0/docs/agent-delegation.md).

## Recovering a cut model stream

- If a model response stream drops mid-answer (connection closed by a relay or proxy, stream ended without completion, read timeout), Wisp reconnects inside the running turn up to 5 times, waiting 1, 3, 8, 20 and 45 seconds. Provider rejections such as 429 keep their own retry schedule.
- Each reconnect rebuilds the request from the confirmed context. Tool results already received are kept and no tool runs twice. The unfinished reply is discarded and does not enter the context or the transcript.
- A notice under the transcript shows the attempt, the wait and the last error. **Stop** cancels the wait. Only when all reconnects fail does the turn end with an error that says how many were tried. See [basic configuration](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.23.0/docs/basic-configuration.md).

## Magpie connection

- When the [Magpie Agent plugin](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/magpie-agents) writes `~/.config/wisp-science/magpie.json`, the desktop app and the CLI run every built-in HTTP model call on that connection. Your own model profiles stay unchanged, and Wisp never writes the file or copies its key into SQLite or the keyring. Changes take effect after a restart. Conversation labels show `Magpie · <model>`.
- The composer's thinking-effort pill lists the connected model's levels and saves your choice on the conversation. A level the model does not support falls back to its default.
- The context gauge now uses the connected model's context window instead of the bound profile's. See [Magpie](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.23.0/docs/magpie.md).

## MCP and Capabilities

- A local (stdio) MCP process is stopped after 15 minutes without use and starts again on the next call. Conversations open in a window, running a turn or showing an MCP App keep theirs. Previously every conversation used since launch kept its own processes, which on one Windows machine reached about 31 GB after three days.
- **Capabilities** now scrolls. Tool name collisions are listed one per line, name the tools involved and say what to do, and are written to `wisp.log` once.
- The Sanger Cell Model Passports tool `search_models` is renamed to `search_cell_models`. It had been hidden by the built-in model search with the same name.

## Conversations

- Finished or failed conversations in other projects appear as small cards at the bottom right with **Open session**. A reply counts as read only when a foreground window shows it. The bell shows a separate dot when only other projects need you.
- Escape closes an open dialog or menu before these cards.

## SwiftUI client (macOS)

- Fixed display differences from the WebView client: right-panel tab close buttons, a close button on the Library sheet, storage shown as "calculating" while loading, no future days in daily usage, model names instead of profile ids in usage, custom MCP connections listed once, settings hints laid out next to their switch, a disabled Create button on an empty new-project form, 1024-based file sizes, and Chinese labels that were in English.

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMGs for Apple Silicon and Intel, with in-app updates for compatible installations. Separate SwiftUI DMGs and checksums are also published.
- **Windows**: MSI / NSIS installers and the separate WinUI 3 preview installers, signed with an SSL.com certificate. This release fixes the signing steps that failed in v1.22.0 builds.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.
- **Mobile**: the signed [Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.23.0/wisp-science_1.23.0_android.apk) installs over the previous version. Install iOS through Xcode.
- **Relay image**: `ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.23.0` and `:latest` for amd64 and arm64.

Desktop assets appear as the platform workflows finish.

[All changes since v1.22.0](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/compare/v1.22.0...v1.23.0)

# wisp-science v1.23.0 — 子代理与断流恢复

**子代理可以用更便宜的模型运行，模型输出流中断也不再结束整个回合。** 子代理的模型可以全局设置，也可以按对话设置。模型回复流中途断开时，Wisp 会在当前回合内自动重连。Wisp 还可以使用 Magpie Agent 插件提供的模型连接，闲置的 MCP 进程会被停止。

## 子代理模型

- **设置 → 专家 → 默认子智能体模型**决定 `delegate_tasks` 子任务和 `dispatch_subagent` 子对话使用的模型。它优先于对话本身的模型，所以一项设置就能让所有子任务不再消耗昂贵模型的额度。
- 输入框的 Agent 菜单在**审查模型**旁新增**子智能体模型**，可以为当前对话选一个模型，或选择**跟随本会话模型**。专家自身绑定的模型和任务的显式指定仍然优先。
- 设置了单独的子代理模型后，Agent 可以把需要完整能力的任务标为 `inherit`，让它使用对话的模型。Agents 面板会显示每个任务和子对话实际使用的模型。

## 受阻的子代理会来问你

- 子代理遇到以下情况时，会停下来把请求交回：除一次项目内尝试外仍需安装软件、需要管理员权限、需要凭据或访问权限、需要改系统或网络设置，或需要你做决定。它会说明需要什么，并给出确切的命令或选项。
- 子代理达到步数上限时，父 Agent 现在会汇报情况并用 `ask_user` 询问你，而不是只附上一段总结。在你回答之前子代理不会再次运行，因此不会反复撞上限。详见 [Agent 委派](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.23.0/docs/agent-delegation.md)。

## 模型输出流中断后自动恢复

- 模型回复流中途断开（中转或代理关闭连接、流未完成就结束、读取超时）时，Wisp 会在当前回合内最多重连 5 次，依次等待 1、3、8、20、45 秒。429 等服务商拒绝仍按原有的重试节奏处理。
- 每次重连都根据已确认的上下文重新发起请求：已经拿到的工具结果保留，不会重复执行任何工具；没写完的回复会被丢弃，不进入上下文，也不留在对话记录里。
- 对话下方会显示当前第几次尝试、等待时间和最近的错误。点**停止**可以取消等待。只有全部重连都失败，回合才会以错误结束，并说明尝试了几次。详见[基础配置](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.23.0/docs/basic-configuration.md)。

## Magpie 连接

- [Magpie Agent 插件](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/magpie-agents)写入 `~/.config/wisp-science/magpie.json` 后，桌面端和 CLI 的所有内置 HTTP 模型调用都会走这个连接。你自己的模型配置保持不变；Wisp 不会写这个文件，也不会把其中的密钥存进 SQLite 或钥匙串。修改在重启后生效。对话标签显示 `Magpie · <模型>`。
- 输入框的思考强度按钮会列出所连模型支持的档位，并把选择保存在当前对话上。模型不支持的档位会退回它的默认档位。
- 上下文用量指示现在按所连模型的上下文窗口计算，不再按绑定的配置计算。详见 [Magpie](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.23.0/docs/magpie.md)。

## MCP 与能力

- 本地（stdio）MCP 进程闲置 15 分钟后会被停止，下次调用时再自动启动。正在窗口中打开、正在运行回合或正在显示 MCP App 的对话不受影响。以前每个启动后用过的对话都会一直保留自己的进程，一台 Windows 机器运行三天后占用了约 31 GB 内存。
- **能力**弹窗现在可以滚动。工具重名问题逐行列出，写明涉及哪些工具以及怎么处理，并且只在 `wisp.log` 中记录一次。
- Sanger Cell Model Passports 的 `search_models` 工具改名为 `search_cell_models`。之前它一直被同名的内置模型搜索工具挡住。

## 对话

- 其他项目里的对话完成或失败时，右下角会出现小卡片，可点**打开会话**。只有前台窗口显示过的回复才算已读。只有其他项目需要你处理时，铃铛会显示一个单独的小圆点。
- 打开对话框或菜单时，Esc 会先关闭它们，再关闭这些卡片。

## SwiftUI 客户端（macOS）

- 修复了与 WebView 客户端的显示差异：右侧面板标签页的关闭按钮、资料库面板新增关闭按钮、存储加载中显示「计算中…」、每日用量不再出现未来日期、用量里显示模型名而不是配置 id、自定义 MCP 连接不再重复列出、设置说明文字与开关并排显示、新建项目表单为空时「创建」不可点、文件大小按 1024 进制显示，以及若干中文界面中残留的英文。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的签名、公证 DMG，兼容安装支持应用内更新；另提供 SwiftUI 版 DMG 和校验文件。
- **Windows**：MSI / NSIS 安装包和独立的 WinUI 3 预览安装包，使用 SSL.com 证书签名。本版本修复了 v1.22.0 构建中失败的签名步骤。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。
- **移动端**：[签名 Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.23.0/wisp-science_1.23.0_android.apk) 可直接覆盖安装旧版本；iOS 通过 Xcode 安装。
- **中继镜像**：`ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.23.0` 与 `:latest`，支持 amd64、arm64。

各平台流水线完成后，桌面安装包会陆续出现在附件中。
